text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-sentence paragraphs with introduction and conclusion","quality":"organizational control","description":"This captures clearer essay structure and paragraphing that guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"repeated explanation of reasons and examples","quality":"development","description":"This captures having more elaboration of ideas rather than only brief fragments."},{"evidence":"connected claims like \"you can create your own ideas\" and \"you can achieve everything by doing it\"","quality":"coherence","description":"This captures linking ideas across sentences so the argument progresses logically."},{"evidence":"full sentences with mostly intelligible wording","quality":"sentence formation","description":"This captures the ability to produce complete, readable sentences despite errors."},{"evidence":"attempts at transitions such as \"In my opinion\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"discourse control","description":"This captures use of basic rhetorical markers to organize and frame the essay."},{"evidence":"a wider range of readable vocabulary like \"manage,\" \"intentions,\" and \"complicate\"","quality":"lexical range","description":"This captures more varied word choice for expressing ideas."}]}
